PRESENTATIONS - None.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF APRIL 9, 2014.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council/Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of April 9, 2014.
04-09-2014 CC-SA Minutes Spc
B-1
APPEAL OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION ACTION - REVOKING UNCLASSIFIED USE PERMIT NO. 199 AND ANY PREVIOUSLY GRANTED LAND USE ENTITLEMENTS PERTAINING TO THE SALE AND ON-SITE OR OFF-SITE CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOL IN CONJUNCTION WITH AN EXISTING RESTAURANT LOCATED AT 663-665 N. GLENDORA AVENUE (EL CAMINANTE RESTAURANT AND BAR)
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council: 1) Consider staff report; 2) Open public hearing and take written and/or oral testimony; 3) Close public hearing; 4) Adopt a Resolution upholding the decision of the Planning Commission's decision, revoking Unclassified Use Permit No. 199.
B-1 Staff Report - Council Appeal Hearing -El Caminante
B-1 Attachment A - PC Resolution - Revoking UUP 199
B-1 Attachment B - Appeal - El Caminante - UUP 199
B-1 Attachment C - Response El Caminante Appeal
B-1 Attachment D - PC Agenda Item - Revoking UUP 199
B-1 Attachment E - CC Resolution - Appeal of UUP 199 Revocation - El Caminante
B-1 Attachment F - Public Records Request - May 2, 2014
B.
PUBLIC HEARING BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
ADOPT THE RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NOS. 1363 AND 21
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt the Resolutions approving Warrant Register Nos. 1363 and 21.
D-1 WR # 1363
D-1 SA WR # 21
D-2
AWARD OF EDUCATION SCHOLARSHIPS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2014-2015
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended by the Education Commission that the City Council: 1) Award ten scholarships for the 2014-2015 academic year in the amount of $500 each; 2) Authorize the Administrative Services Director to place $5,184 in scholarship fund for FY 2015-2016; and 3) Schedule a presentation of awards during the May 27, 2014 City Council Meeting.
D-2 Scholarship Awards FY 2014-15 Staff Report
D-2 Scholarship Awardees FY 2014-15 Attach A
D-3
ACCEPTANCE OF WORK/NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR SEWER IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT PHASE IV AND STREET RESURFACING - RAMONA, INC.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council: 1) Accept the project as complete; and 2) Authorize the City Clerk to execute the Notice of Completion.
D-3 Staff Report - Sewer Phase IV - Notice of Completion
D-3 Attach A - Sewer Phase IV - Notice of Completion
D-4
LIABILITY AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOR THE COUNTYWIDE HOUSEHOLD HAZARDOUS WASTE COLLECTION EVENT
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Countywide Household Hazardous Waste Collection Program Siting Liability Agreement and authorize the Mayor to sign the agreement.
D-4 Staff Report - Hazardous Waste Collection Event
D-4 Attachment A - Household Haz Waste Agreement - 2014
D-5
ADOPT THE RESOLUTION APPOINTING ROBBEYN BIRD, DIRECTOR OF ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES, AS THE CITY TREASURER
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt a Resolution appointing the Director of Administrative Services as the City Treasurer.
D-5 Appointment of Treasurer - Staff Report
D-5 Attachment A - appointment of treasurer resolution
D-6
THIRD QUARTER INVESTMENT REPORT
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-6 Staff Report on Third Quarter Investment Report
D-6 Attachment A - LAIF Rates
D-6 Attachment B -LAIF Statement as of March 31, 2014
D-6 Attachment C - Union Bank Statement as of March 31, 2014
D-7
APPROVE AN EXCLUSIVE NEGOTIATION AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE AGENCY AND FRONTIER REAL ESTATE INVESTMENTS, INC. FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 1545 N. HACIENDA BOULEVARD, LA PUENTE
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Agency Board approve the exclusive negotiation agreement with Frontier Real Estate Investments, Inc.
D-7 Staff Report - Approval of ERN - Frontier Investments
D-7 Attachment A - EXCLUSIVE NEGOTIATION AGREEMENT - Frontier
D-7 Exhibit A to Exclusive Negotiation Agreement (Attachment A) - Frontier

E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
MAYOR'S APPOINTMENTS TO VARIOUS BOARD POSITIONS
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that: 1) The Mayor make appointments to the various agency boards; and 2) The Mayor and City Council adopt the resolution appointing specific representatives to the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments.

7:00 P.M. OPEN SESSION AGENDA
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
